    px, py = observation.get('self_position', (0, 0))
    ox, oy = observation.get('opponent_position', (px, py))
    resources = observation.get('resources', [])
    territory_targets = observation.get('territory_targets', [])
    # Prioritize resources
    for res in resources:
        res_x, res_y = res
        if res_x != px or res_y != py:
            dx = 0 if res_x == px else (1 if res_x > px else -1)
            dy = 0 if res_y == py else (1 if res_y > py else -1)
            if dx in [-1, 0, 1] and dy in [-1, 0, 1]:
                return [dx, dy]
    # Next, go for territory targets if no resources
    for target in territory_targets:
        tx, ty = target
        if tx != px or ty != py:
            dx = 0 if tx == px else (1 if tx > px else -1)
            dy = 0 if ty == py else (1 if ty > py else -1)
            if dx in [-1, 0, 1] and dy in [-1, 0, 1]:
                return [dx, dy]
    # Pursue opponent if no other target
    if ox != px or oy != py:
        dx = 0 if ox == px else (1 if ox > px else -1)
        dy = 0 if oy == py else (1 if oy > py else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    # If no info, stay still
    return [0, 0]
